about.heading: About
about.subtitle: The short version
about.bio1: I'm {name}, a {title} based in Jember, East Java. I build software across web, mobile, and APIs.
about.bio2: My work spans native Android apps, TypeScript SDKs, REST APIs, and full-stack web platforms. I've published npm packages, built AI-powered integrations, and shipped apps on Google Play — all driven by a focus on clean architecture and practical engineering.
about.bio3: Before that, I spent time at BuildWithAngga developing production UIs with Next.js, volunteered on web projects with an international team at Kerja IT Jepang, and spent four years freelancing on Android and web apps for diverse clients.
about.bio4: What I care about is building things that work. Type safety. Clean architecture. Good documentation. Fast load times. The stuff that actually matters when software needs to run in production.
about.bio5: I'm currently open to full-time opportunities where I can contribute to products that have real impact.
